source_title: Eternal eyes faster Blinkit expansion as margins and order values grow - Business Standard
source_excerpt: Eternal delivered fairly positive Q2FY27 results and confident commentary. The food delivery (FD) business saw stable margins and growth rates at the higher end of consensus estimates. Quick commerce (QC) has high competitive intensity and Blinkit is accelerating its network rollout. Hyperpure and District look to be on promising trajectories. The company is also making a potentially high-reward gamble in AI development. It doesn’t think agentic commerce is a threat as yet.
